units.source_text: 看到衣服下摆，岛村不由得一惊：她到底还是当艺妓了么！

en.t: At the sight of the hem of her clothing, Shimamura started: had she really become a geisha after all!

units.source_text: 可是她没有向这边走来，也没有动动身子作出迎客的娇态。

en.t: But she did not come walking toward him, nor did she move her body into any coquettish gesture of welcome.

units.source_text: 从老远望去，她那婷婷玉立的姿势，使他感受到一种真挚的感情。

en.t: Seen from far off, her slender upright posture made him feel something sincere.

units.source_text: 他连忙走了过去，默默地站在女子身边。

en.t: He hurried over and stood silently beside the woman.

units.source_text: 女子也想绽开她那浓施粉黛的脸，结果适得其反，变成了一副哭丧的脸。

en.t: The woman, too, tried to make her heavily powdered face break into a smile, but the effort had the opposite effect and turned it into a tearful face.

units.source_text: 两人就那么默然无言地向房间走去。

en.t: The two of them walked toward the room in silence, just like that.
